facts.fact: The article lists the Access to Information Act 2005 among the legislation the Bank of Uganda's complaints mechanism adheres to.

UGA.note: Complaints procedure for banks; no statement on payment licensing, a switch or PAPSS.

facts.fact: The Bank of Uganda runs a Financial Consumer Empowerment Mechanism that takes customer complaints about supervised financial institutions after 21 days without a satisfactory answer from the institution, guided by the Mobile Money Guidelines 2013 among others.

UGA.note: Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
Mobile Money Guidelines 2013 are only named in passing, with no statement of their standing or non-bank licensing.
Document gives no account survey figure.
Document states nothing on mobile money service or interoperability.
Document states nothing on electronic revenue payment.
